author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
To our knowledge, this is the first consumer photo printer that can also cut full color stickers in the same machine. We test and review the Liene PixCut S1 sticker maker, which combines dye sublimation photo printing with a two-axis drag knife cutter. From setup to software, here's how we envision using this machine in our build workflow. 

Liene PixCut S1 printer and sticker cutter: https://amzn.to/4sS6bYp
Sticker pack and ink cartridge refill: https://amzn.to/4uQRohN
Disclaimer: Tested may earn a commission from purchases made via the links above. 

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
